title: Maximum Trailing Zeros in a Cornered Path
goal: Maximize trailing zeros in the product along a path with at most one corner.
strategy: Trailing zeros depend on the minimum of total factors of two and five. Row and column prefix sums evaluate four boundary-reaching L shapes at every corner, subtracting the corner factor once.
